title: [Feature request] add an option to view previous wallpaper when using wallpaper slideshow style on the desktop
line: Slideshow wallpapers now have a "Previous Wallpaper Image" item in the desktop context menu, next to "Next Wallpaper Image".
explanation: The slideshow wallpaper only offered "Next Wallpaper Image" in the desktop context menu (plus a global shortcut), so once the slideshow moved on there was no way to get the previous image back. The backend only knew how to advance its index. The change adds a previousSlide() that steps the slideshow index back by one (wrapping to the last image), shows and saves that image and restarts the slideshow timer, exposed as a "Previous Wallpaper Image" action with its own assignable global shortcut, placed before Next in the menu.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add a Previous Wallpaper Image action to slideshows

Slideshow wallpapers could only move forward from the desktop context
menu, so a wallpaper that had just been replaced could not be brought
back. Add a matching action and global shortcut that go back one image.

BUG: 497537

media.caption: Slideshow wallpaper: the desktop menu only has Next Wallpaper Image
With the fix: Previous Wallpaper Image sits right above Next Wallpaper Image
Before: the menu can only go forward (1 → 2)
After: from 2, Previous shows 1, Previous again wraps to 4, Next goes back to 1
